name: B10-0094/2026 (S&D) – Case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese humanitarian worker held in the Central African Republic. He was kidnapped in May 2024, held over a year without trial, tortured, and then sentenced in November 2025 to ten years of hard labour on charges the Parliament says are forged. The Parliament asks the Central African Republic to overturn the conviction and free him, and asks the European Union and its member states to push for his release and better protection of aid workers.

- Nothing changes yet: the Parliament is only stating its position and making requests.
- It concerns Joseph Figueira Martin, the Central African Republic, and European Union institutions.
- Next: the EU and member states are asked to act; the Parliament's President sends the text to the parties involved.
